_comment: Atlas Growth UK generators :: RECOVERY pass over excluded_officp.csv — the UNRATED track. Verbatim sibling of recover-unrated-uk-config.json (the 2026-09-16 foundation run, GATE 3 / P7, operator-approved), re-pointed at the generator config's rule labels. It reverses exactly one accident: a Maps listing with NO review data is deleted by the review floor because qualify-leads.js:92 treats a blank review_count as a failed '>= 5' (num('') -> null -> false; probed 2026-09-16, output in the foundation run's dryrun2-results.md). Deterministic, $0, no re-scrape. Run: qualify-leads.js --in <run>/excluded_officp.csv --config recover-unrated-generators-uk-config.json --out <run>/recover-unrated, then append recover-unrated/leads_clean_qualified.csv to the main qualified list through the MAIN header (PIPELINE.md STEP 3), asserting zero place_id overlap.
_r_why_no_entity_rules: This pass does NOT repeat rules 1-3 of atlas-growth-generators-uk-config.json, by construction: qualify-leads.js breaks on the FIRST failing rule and writes that rule's label, and the review floor is rule 4 — the LAST rule — so a row labelled too_small has ALREADY passed the primary deny, the name deny and the ICP allow. Re-applying them could only repeat the verdict.
_r_track_marker: No track column and none is needed: rule 1 admits ONLY rows whose review_count is empty and the main list contains none, so in the merged file review_count == '' is exactly the unrated track.

qualify_rules._r: 0. RECOVERY SCOPE GATE — one drop reason only, so this pass can never re-litigate a deny. CAVEAT: pointed at a file with NO drop_reason column, qualify-leads.js skips this rule with a WARN on stderr and the pass degrades to 'every unrated row with a website', which readmits hire yards and merchants wholesale. Read the WARN line; it is a STOP.
qualify_rules.label: not_an_unrated_candidate

qualify_rules._r: 1. UNRATED ONLY. The 1-4 band was judged on real review data and the floor's verdict on it stands (that band IS the ghost filter).
qualify_rules.label: has_review_count

qualify_rules._r: 2. A LIVE WEBSITE is the substitute activity signal. The only website gate in this run's rule set, applied only because an unrated AND site-less listing carries zero evidence of being a going concern. collapse-domains.js still routes a Facebook/Checkatrade-only site to the no-website track downstream.
qualify_rules.label: no_website
